title: nstdb-offsets: per-segment offsets in MIT-BIH Noise Stress Test records and their effect on ECG denoising scores
description: Code and results for the paper 'Constant Offsets in the MIT-BIH Noise Stress Test Records Inflate ECG Denoising Results'. The WFDB program nst holds a continuity term constant over every 2-minute segment of the records it makes. These offsets carry 85-92 % of the added noise variance and add about 8-11 dB to the SNR improvement of any method that removes the band below 0.5 Hz. The repository reads the published NSTDB records with an independent decoder, re-implements nst, measures the effect on 48 MIT-BIH records for em, ma and bw noise, re-runs a published evaluation protocol, and provides a tool that removes the offsets.
